name: Tamai Tsugumi
source: She is a first-year student in the same art club as the main character, and despite her somewhat young appearance, she always has a calm expression and mature behavior. She has a polite and courteous personality, but is not afraid of older people. Because of her attitude, the protagonist sees her as a cocky bitch who he wants to bark at someday.
